verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal exposes an API-based integration and documents API-driven creation of Locations and registration of readers (via registration code, serial number, or order number), which an agent could call end-to-end. However, evidence doesn't confirm a single unified 'provision location + register reader' agentic workflow, nor explicit agent/AI-driven examples of this fleet task, and reader registration methods like pairing codes still imply some physical/manual step. missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end example or SDK/agent tutorial showing programmatic location creation plus reader registration in one flow, and confirmation that all registration methods are fully non-physical/agent-executable.
